categoryA.title: Category-A (Convener Quota - 70% seats)
categoryA.eligibility: Passed 10+2 (Intermediate) with MPC (Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry) and qualified in AP EAPCET.
categoryA.admissionProcess: Conducted by the Andhra Pradesh State Council of Higher Education (APSCHE) through centralized online web counseling.
counselingSteps: Register on the APSCHE EAPCET web counseling portal.
Complete online certificate verification at assigned helpline centers or online.
Exercise web options giving 'SRKR' (Bhimavaram) as top preference for your desired branch.
Check allotment order, download allotment letter, and pay tuition fee via portal if applicable.
Report in person at SRKR Admissions Cell with original certificates and payment proof before the cutoff date.

categoryB.title: Category-B (Management / NRI Quota - 30% seats)
categoryB.eligibility: Passed 10+2 with minimum 45% aggregate in MPC. Candidates with valid JEE Main or AP EAPCET ranks are given priority; remaining seats filled based on Intermediate marks merit.
categoryB.process: Applications invited through official SRKR notification on www.srkrec.ac.in and verified via APSCHE Category-B portal.
categoryB.guidance: Parents and candidates can visit the Administrative Block Admissions Desk or call the college admissions helpline (+91 9848823332).

lateralEntry.title: Lateral Entry (ECET Quota)
lateralEntry.eligibility: Diploma holders or B.Sc (Mathematics) graduates qualified in AP ECET can enter directly into the 2nd year (3rd semester) of B.Tech.
lateralEntry.percentage: 10% supernumerary seats allocated through AP ECET counseling.

mtech.title: Postgraduate (M.Tech) Admissions
mtech.eligibility: Valid GATE or AP PGECET qualification with relevant B.Tech degree.

feeStructure.btechTuitionGovt: As fixed by AP Higher Education Regulatory and Monitoring Commission (APHERMC), approx. ₹70,000 - ₹73,000 per annum for Convener Quota.
scholarshipSchemes: Jagananna Vidya Deevena (JVD): 100% tuition fee reimbursement credited to eligible student mothers' accounts for Category-A students.
Jagananna Vasathi Deevena: Financial assistance for hostel and mess expenses.
National Scholarship Portal (NSP) schemes for minority and central category candidates.

academics.regulations: Autonomous R20 / R23 Regulations following AICTE Model Curriculum and Choice Based Credit System (CBCS).
academics.creditSystem: Total of 160 credits required over 4 years for B.Tech degree; Honors and Minors degree tracks available for meritorious students (CGPA >= 7.5).

attendanceRules.condonationCondition: Permitted only on genuine medical grounds certified by the college medical officer and recommended by HOD upon paying the prescribed Condonation Fee.
attendanceRules.detentionPolicy: Students with less than 65% aggregate attendance are strictly DETAINED for that semester and must repeat the semester in the subsequent academic year.

evaluationScheme.internalCIE: 30 or 40 marks (Continuous Internal Evaluation: 2 mid examinations, objective quizzes, assignment/coding assignments)
evaluationScheme.semesterSEE: 70 or 60 marks (Semester End Examinations conducted autonomously by the Examination Cell)
evaluationScheme.passCriteria: Minimum 35% in SEE and 40% aggregate in CIE + SEE combined.

examCellServices: Semester End Examination schedules and hall ticket issuance
Revaluation / Recounting application processing (within 10 days of results declaration)
Official Transcripts for higher education / WES evaluation
Duplicate grade memos and certificate verification

faq.q: What is the EAPCET counseling code for SRKR Engineering College?
faq.a: The AP EAPCET counseling code for SRKR Engineering College is **SRKR**.
Yes, SRKR is an Autonomous institution affiliated with JNTUK Kakinada and accredited with NAAC Grade 'A+' (CGPA 3.42) and NBA accreditation for its core UG programs.

faq.q: What is the attendance criteria to appear for semester exams?
faq.a: A minimum of 75% aggregate attendance is mandatory. Condonation between 65% and 74% may be granted strictly on valid medical grounds with a prescribed fee. Students with less than 65% attendance are detained.

faq.q: How can I apply for Category-B / Management seats?
faq.a: Category-B admissions open after official notification following intermediate results. Candidates can apply online via the APSCHE Category-B portal or approach the SRKR Admissions Desk at China Amiram, Bhimavaram with 10+2 marks memos and rank cards.

faq.q: What was the highest salary package offered in placements?
faq.a: The highest package offered to SRKR students is ₹44 LPA by Palo Alto Networks and Amazon. The average package across branches is approximately ₹5.5 to ₹6.5 LPA.

faq.q: Are there hostel facilities for outstation students?
faq.a: Yes, separate secure hostels for boys and girls with RO water, solar hot water, high-speed Wi-Fi, hygienic food mess, 24/7 security, and resident wardens are available.

faq.q: How do I get my official transcripts or degree certificates?
faq.a: Transcripts and provisional certificates are processed through the Controller of Examinations (COE) office. You can submit the transcript requisition form along with required fee receipts at the Exam Cell or apply via the official exam portal.
